author: feral-core
description: Control the local computer's UI: open any app, take screenshots, adjust volume, and read system info. Runs one allowlisted program at a time with no shell metacharacters, so it cannot create, read, or edit files. Use coding_tools__write_file / read_file / edit_file / bash for anything touching the filesystem or running a program.

endpoints.description: Open ANY application on the user's Mac using AppleScript. Use this whenever the user asks to open, launch, or start an app (Music, Safari, Chrome, Spotify, Notes, Terminal, Finder, etc.). The script parameter should be AppleScript like: tell application "AppName" to activate. AppleScript that reaches a shell or another interpreter (`do shell script`, `do script`, `run script`, `use framework`) is rejected.

params.name: script
params.description: AppleScript to execute. MUST use format: tell application "AppName" to activate. Examples: tell application "Music" to activate, tell application "Safari" to activate, tell application "Notes" to activate

endpoints.description: Run one allowlisted program on the user's Mac. The command must be a single program from the daemon shell allowlist (open, osascript, screencapture, say, pbcopy, pbpaste, defaults, system_profiler, sw_vers, caffeinate, mdfind, date, uname) with plain arguments. Shell metacharacters ($ ` | & ; > < \) are rejected, so pipes, redirects, command substitution and chaining do NOT work here. To create or edit a file, use coding_tools__write_file. To run git, tests, or any other program, use coding_tools__bash.

params.name: command
params.description: One allowlisted program with arguments, no metacharacters. Examples: open -a Safari, screencapture -x /tmp/screenshot.png, pbpaste, sw_vers, mdfind kMDItemDisplayName=='notes.txt'

endpoints.description: Capture a screenshot of the user's screen to /tmp/feral_screenshot.png.

params.name: command
params.description: Screenshot command. Must stay a single allowlisted program with no metacharacters.

endpoints.description: Get hardware and OS information for this Mac (model, chip, memory, OS version).

params.name: command
params.description: System info command. Must stay a single allowlisted program with no metacharacters.

endpoints.returns_description: {output, exit_code}: the system_profiler hardware report as text

endpoints.description: Set the system volume level on the Mac.

params.name: command
params.description: osascript command for volume. Example: osascript -e 'set volume output volume 50'
